<div class="js_slider w-embed w-script"><style>
  [data-slideshow="wrap"] .gallery_slider_list {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  [data-slideshow="wrap"] .gallery_slider {
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  [data-slideshow="wrap"] [data-slideshow="slide"] {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateZ(0);
    visibility: hidden;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  [data-slideshow="wrap"] [data-slideshow="slide"].is--current {
    z-index: 2;
    visibility: visible;
    opacity: 1;
  }

  [data-slideshow="wrap"]:not(:has([data-slideshow="slide"].is--current))
    [data-slideshow="slide"]:first-child {
    visibility: visible;
    opacity: 1;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  [data-slideshow="wrap"] [data-slideshow="slide"]:not(.is--current) {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  [data-slideshow="wrap"] [data-slideshow="slide"] .gallery_img-slide__inner,
  [data-slideshow="wrap"] [data-slideshow="slide"] [data-slideshow="parallax"] {
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateZ(0);
  }

  [data-slideshow="nav"] .nav_item {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  [data-slideshow="nav"] [data-slideshow="thumb"] {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  [data-slideshow="nav"] .nav_item > .slideshow-thumb-progress,
  [data-slideshow="nav"] [data-slideshow="thumb"] > .slideshow-thumb-progress {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    top: auto;
    width: 100%;
    height: 0;
    z-index: 3;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  }
</style>
